adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, when the parsed token payload lacks `refresh_token`, it is forcibly set to the literal string `"refresh_token"` (lines ~23-28). This can overwrite a previously valid stored refresh token when callers merge the parsed data back into existing credentials. For example, in `office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the result of `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)` is spread into `o365AuthCredentials` (`{ ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }`), so a missing `refresh_token` from the provider response would become the placeholder string and break future refreshes. Similar risk exists where refreshed token payloads are stored/updated based on the parsed response (e.g., Zoom).
